title: Duplex Pet Screening Form
subtitle: Operational pet screening intake, evidence, qualified review, exception routing, handoff, and accountable closeout.
description: An original fillable duplex pet screening workflow that keeps identity, property-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exceptions, communication, and closeout in one traceable record.
use_case: Use when authorized property staff need to manage a duplex pet screening from intake through verified handoff without using the record to make legal, accommodation, screening, compliance, or professional conclusions.

blocks.label: Pet Screening reference
blocks.guidance: Use one identifier across messages, evidence, work orders, and handoffs.

blocks.label: Property and location
blocks.guidance: Confirm the exact property record before collecting workflow details.

blocks.label: Reporting and routing contact
blocks.guidance: Record only contact information needed to route and update this record.

blocks.label: Request timing
blocks.guidance: Do not collect unnecessary medical, disability, or personal information.

sections.title: Classification before household-pet screening
sections.guidance: Route protected requests before pet review.

blocks.label: Request classification and route
blocks.guidance: When classification is unclear, pause household-pet screening.

blocks.label: Assistance, service, and accommodation safeguard
blocks.guidance: Do not use this pet screen to decide an assistance-animal, service-animal, disability, accessibility, or accommodation request. Do not request diagnosis or unnecessary medical details. Pause pet rules, charges, scores, and registration requirements until the established qualified process provides authorized operational direction.

blocks.label: Communication and process support
blocks.guidance: Checking an item records routing, not an eligibility decision.
items: Requester's own classification wording is preserved
Only necessary operational contact information is recorded
Requested communication or process support is routed
Interpreter, accessible format, or authorized contact route is recorded
Sensitive supporting records are not stored in this pet form
Pet fees or restrictions are paused for protected-route review
Qualified reviewer and response due point are assigned
Requester receives the correct process and follow-up contact

blocks.label: Classification facts, requester wording, and unresolved routing question
blocks.guidance: Avoid medical conclusions, credibility judgments, or protected-trait details.

fields.label: Request as stated, route selected, information not collected, reviewer, due point, and next contact

blocks.label: Operational and qualified-review boundary
blocks.guidance: This pet screening record captures operational facts, routing, evidence, and authorized handoffs. It does not determine legal rights, tenancy, responsibility, habitability, code or accessibility compliance, accommodation eligibility, screening eligibility, or a professional opinion. Authorized property staff must review applicable policy, notice, privacy, retention, fair-housing, safety, insurance, and licensed-trade requirements.

sections.title: Household-pet identity, care, and proportionate records

blocks.label: Household-pet identity
blocks.guidance: Use factual identifiers; do not infer behavior from a label or appearance.

blocks.label: Care and emergency contacts
blocks.guidance: Collect only contacts needed for the written household-pet process.

blocks.label: Required household-pet record log
blocks.guidance: Request only records required by the current written policy and applicable process.

blocks.label: Daily care, containment, waste, absence, and emergency plan
blocks.guidance: Use operational facts rather than broad promises.

fields.label: Routine, access areas, containment, waste handling, time alone, backup care, and emergency steps

sections.title: Duplex context and responsibility
sections.guidance: Apply controls that are specific to this property type.

blocks.label: Duplex workflow controls
blocks.guidance: Check only controls actually reviewed; explain exceptions in the routing note.
items: Animal request is tied to the correct duplex side and household
Assistance or accommodation requests leave the pet workflow immediately
Shared yard, porch, drive, and entry plan is described
Cross-unit noise, waste, escape, and contact concerns use factual details
Other household preferences do not substitute for written policy review
Containment and emergency contact plans cover shared access
Pet conditions are not applied to the other household's record
Approved registration is linked to the correct unit record

blocks.label: Responsibility and external handoff
blocks.guidance: A routing field records ownership; it does not decide disputed responsibility.

blocks.label: Duplex coordination facts and unresolved questions
blocks.guidance: Separate observed facts from assumptions and identify the next authorized reviewer.

fields.label: Property-specific facts, limitations, handoff details, and unresolved question

sections.title: Factual history, written criteria, and qualified review

blocks.label: Requester-reported factual history
blocks.guidance: A checked item records a report, not a verified finding or legal characterization.
items: Prior housing or facility reference is identified when required
Current licensing or registration status is recorded when required
Caregiver describes containment and supervised-access practices
Any disclosed bite, injury, escape, damage, or complaint has details
No incident history was reported by the requester
Emergency and temporary-care contacts are available
Requested exception or variance is identified for separate review
Missing information and response due point are communicated

blocks.label: Disclosed incident or concern details
blocks.guidance: Describe specific events; do not substitute breed, type, size, or appearance for facts.

blocks.label: Written household-pet criteria review
blocks.guidance: Do not apply household-pet criteria to a protected-route request.

blocks.label: Missing fact, requested exception, conflicting record, or escalation
blocks.guidance: Do not make an adverse or accommodation decision from incomplete routing.

fields.label: Issue, information requested, interim status, qualified reviewer, due point, and disposition route

sections.title: Authorized communication, registration, and closeout
sections.guidance: Keep decision authority and handoff visible.

blocks.label: Household-pet workflow decision
blocks.guidance: This row records the authorized result; it does not decide a protected request.

blocks.label: Approved condition, registration, or action
blocks.guidance: Do not enter household-pet charges or conditions for a protected-route request.

blocks.label: Registration and handoff verification
blocks.guidance: Registration does not waive the requester's right to correct facts or use another applicable process.
items: Authorized result and written source are linked
Requester received the decision through the approved channel
Required household-pet records are stored in the approved location
Only necessary staff received operational animal information
Access, security, facilities, or resident-service instructions are updated
Renewal or record-expiration dates have owners
Correction, reconsideration, or separate accommodation route was communicated
Open actions retain owners, due points, and escalation routes

blocks.label: Registration and closeout status
blocks.guidance: Keep the workflow open while a required item lacks disposition.

blocks.label: Requester correction, disagreement, withdrawal, or follow-up
blocks.guidance: Preserve the requester's response without requiring waiver or agreement.

fields.label: Response, added evidence, requested correction, receiving owner, due point, and status

blocks.label: Workflow preparation and qualified closeout review
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge review or receipt of this operational record, not an accommodation decision or waiver.
